name: Vienna Game
description: A flexible 1.e4 opening where White develops the queen's knight early and can build attacking chances.

moves.explanation: White opens the center and frees the kingside bishop.
White develops a knight while supporting e4 and preparing flexible plans.

ideas: Develop naturally while keeping options open.
Consider f4 only when it fits the position.
Avoid launching an attack before your king is safe.
commonMistakes: Pushing f4 without understanding the opened lines.
Forgetting to develop the kingside knight.
Leaving the king in the center too long.
